svg.title: Three actors share room for two, for ten minutes
svg.desc: A timeline of 600 seconds on the second x86 server guest. The worker has room for two actors of one CPU each. The actor busy gets a request each 5 seconds and runs for the whole time. The actor bursty gets five requests each 150 seconds, and the suspender suspends it 4 times after 30 quiet seconds. The actor rare gets two requests and is suspended 2 times. All 140 requests returned 200. The worker had one CPU booked in 38 of 58 samples and two in the rest.
